newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE wheat little changed, volume low.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE wheat little changed, volume low.

text.p: LIFFE wheat ended a quiet day's business little changed, despite the strength of sterling.
November, with 114 lots done of a total 229 was most active. It last traded unchanged at 86.25 stg.
Front month July last traded 0.05 stg higher at 81.05 stg, on volume of 51 lots.
There were 85 lots of barley traded, 78 on November, which last traded 0.35 stg lower at 84.40 stg.
One trader noted that the market was holding up despite the strength of sterling, which at one point rose to 2.8895 marks, the highest level since July 1992.
Physical market traders report a quiet day, with the market still suffering from a lack of sellers. But the prices paid have firmed.
Brokers reported feed wheat done to Norfolk/Suffolk for July 84.25 stg, 84.50 stg and 85.00 stg during the course of the day.
